description: Defines the Legend class for chart legends in the MigraDoc document object model, including properties, cloning, serialization, and visitor pattern implementation.

classes.name: Legend
classes.description: Represents a chart legend with properties for style, format, and line format, including cloning and serialization capabilities.

classes.name: Legend.LegendValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for Legend, including style, format, and line format.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Legend object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation, cloning nested format objects.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Legend object into a DDL format.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Indicates whether the Legend object is null (always false).
